Fonts and helper files for Chinese, Arabic and India's scripts in the TeX tree (the hosted Rikuy only)

Noto Serif Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam and Gurmukhi, Noto
Sans Oriya and Noto Nastaliq Urdu (regular and bold)
  Copyright 2012-2020 Google LLC and the Noto Project Authors (https://github.com/notofonts).
  SIL Open Font License 1.1 (its text is build/fonts/OFL.txt in Rikuy's source and stands in
  LICENSES.txt under Paper Modern). From Ubuntu's fonts-noto-core.

Amiri 1.003 (Amiri-Regular, Bold, Italic, BoldItalic)
  Copyright 2010-2022 The Amiri Project Authors (https://github.com/aliftype/amiri).
  SIL Open Font License 1.1 (its text is build/fonts/OFL.txt in Rikuy's source and stands in
  LICENSES.txt under Paper Modern). From Ubuntu's fonts-hosny-amiri.

Fandol (FandolSong, FandolHei, FandolKai, FandolFang, FandolBraille)
  Copyright 2012-2013, the Fandol team.
  GNU General Public License 3 (LICENSES/GPL-3.0.txt) with the font exception: as a special
  exception, if you create a document which uses this font, and embed this font or unaltered
  portions of this font into the document, this font does not by itself cause the resulting
  document to be covered by the GNU General Public License. From TeX Live (texlive-lang-chinese).

The CJK package 4.8.5 for pdfLaTeX (Werner Lemberg), from Ubuntu's latex-cjk-common and
latex-cjk-chinese
  GNU General Public License 2 or later (LICENSES/GPL-2.0.txt).

Arphic fonts as Type 1 for the CJK package: AR PL SungtiL GB (gbsn), AR PL KaitiM GB (gkai),
AR PL Mingti2L Big5 (bsmi), AR PL KaitiM Big5 (bkai), from Ubuntu's
latex-cjk-chinese-arphic packages
